headerDisplay: Adds exactly one switch to HomeKit: On = Tado Home mode, Off = Tado Away mode. On the first start the plugin prints a Tado sign-in link to the Homebridge log; open it in a browser and approve. The session is stored and renewed automatically.
footerDisplay: The switch sets Tado's presence lock, the same Home/Away switch as in the Tado app.

name.title: Name
name.description: The name of the switch in HomeKit.

homeName.title: Tado Home Name
homeName.description: The name of the Tado home, exactly as in the Tado app. Optional: if empty, the first home of the account is used.

pollSeconds.title: Poll Interval (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often the current Home/Away state is read from Tado, so changes made in the Tado app show up in HomeKit.
